record.kind: marker passive with no PassiveEffects entry; the behaviour is implemented outside combat, in Player.updateRegionalPool (a forced evolution into Mothim on a map change), not by the passive's own effect
record.summary: Passive.BURMY has no combat effect and no PassiveEffects entry; the only code that reads it is Player.updateRegionalPool. When a player's map changes (mapChanged true, not on the town map) at stageLevel 20 or later and at least one Burmy is on the player's board, each Burmy's cloak type (Plant = GRASS, Sandy = GROUND, Trash = ARTIFICIAL) is compared with the synergies of the new region; if any cloak type is missing from the region's synergies, the FIRST Burmy of the list is evolved at once into Mothim through EvolutionManager.evolve (a forced evolution that skips canEvolve and the 3-copy requirement). Separately the normal rule is 3 copies evolve into the matching Wormadam (COUNT rule with a divergentEvolution).
triggers: Player.updateRegionalPool(state, mapChanged = true, previousMap) called after a map change by an item (items.ts, 10 s after the dialog) or by a portal at a carousel stage (mini-game.ts); the constructor call and the two mapChanged = false calls do not reach the block
normal evolution: three Burmy of the same name (COUNT rule, handled by the generic evolution code, not by this passive)

effects.declaredRaw: forced Burmy -> Mothim when any Burmy cloak type is not among the new region's synergies, only at stageLevel >= 20 and only on a map change
effects.scaling: none (no AP, no crit, no combat effect)
effects.resolution: requested: burmys[0].evolutionRule.divergentEvolution is replaced by () => Mothim on that unit's own rule object, then EvolutionManager.evolve runs the COUNT handler; the handler copies the function at construction, so getEvolution returns Mothim. applied: the handler collects up to 3 copies of the same name as burmys[0] that do not hold Eviolite (so with a single copy only that one is consumed), deletes them from the board, builds a Mothim from the factory with their summed permanent stat deltas and the Burmy's stacks, moves items and dishes over, and places it at the best coordinate collected. afterEvolve then updates synergies and calls tryEvolve on the new unit. What is removed: all collected copies; what is added: one Mothim.

conditions: Runs only inside the mapChanged branch of updateRegionalPool, never on the town map, and only when state.stageLevel >= 20 at that moment.
Which Burmy evolves: only burmys[0], the first in the board's iteration order; its cloak does not matter for who is chosen, only the whole list's cloak types decide whether the condition holds.

Condition: RegionDetails[this.map]?.synergies.includes(type) === false for any of the board's Burmy cloak types. An unknown map (undefined) makes the test false, so nothing evolves. Which maps contain which synergies (RegionDetails) was not read.
Mothim is reached only through the forced path above: the three unit blocks list both a Wormadam and Mothim in evolutions, but each COUNT rule's divergentEvolution returns the matching Wormadam.

The forced evolve consumes up to 3 copies of burmys[0]'s name (not holding Eviolite), not just one: with 2 or 3 same-name copies (3 would already have evolved normally) all collected copies are replaced by one Mothim.

Source-reading observation, not tested: if burmys[0] holds Eviolite and no other copy of that name without Eviolite exists, CountEvolutionHandler.evolve collects no copies, and carryOverPermanentStats reads pokemonsBeforeEvolution[0].name unconditionally; nothing in the cited code guards an empty list.

The regional pool membership of each cloak (isInRegion: Plant if the region has GRASS; Sandy if GROUND and not GRASS; Trash if ARTIFICIAL and neither) is a separate shop mechanic; Mothim.isInRegion always returns false so it is never offered in the pool.
The player's board includes bench units as far as the cited code shows (positionX -1 for bench); the placement step only gets a coordinate if a collected copy has positionX != -1.
record.resetBehaviour: No counter or state on the unit is kept by the passive. The block is evaluated each time a map change reaches updateRegionalPool; there is no flag preventing a second forced evolution on a later map change if a Burmy is still on the board (a Mothim is not a Burmy and has no passive). The new Mothim receives the old copies' stacks value.
